metadataRaw.title: 30 SECOND FIX: Instant Rhomboid Muscle Pain Relief
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe tackles a real pain in the upper back — the rhomboid muscles!

If you’re dealing with tightness, soreness, or burning pain between your shoulder blades, your rhomboids are likely the problem. These muscles sit between the shoulder blades, and when they get strained or inflamed, they can cause pain below the neck that spreads across the upper back and toward the shoulder blade (scapula).

The main causes? Muscle tightness and weakness that build up over time, leading to strain and irritation.

In this video, Dr. Rowe shows easy rhomboid exercises that help stretch, strengthen, and relieve upper back pain — for both quick and long-lasting results.

Each exercise works differently, so try them all and use the ones that give you the most relief.

Best of all, these moves can be done at home and may relieve pain in as little as 30 seconds!

Watch now and fix rhomboid muscle pain fast!
